work: T-0925 / PRED-0010: Open CFTR theratype benchmark testing whether AlphaMissense predicts CFTR modulator responsiveness across missense, in-frame indel, splicing, and Class I nonsense/frameshift variants on a domain- and position-disjoint split against US FDA SPL labels (TRIKAFTA v23 Table 6, ALYFTREK v9 Table 5) and MyVariant/dbNSFP open annotations.

claims.statement: Canonical ENST00000003084 / P13569 AlphaMissense scores retrieved from MyVariant dbnsfp.alphamissense reproduce 7 of 7 CFTR2 Variants of Unknown Significance (R31L=0.17, V201M=0.36, A349V=0.26, S912L=0.12, D924N=0.83, M952T=0.85, Y1014C=0.37) reported in Table 1 of McDonald et al. (2024, PMC10810519) with 0 codon overlap against the 30 train/test benchmark variants.

methods.name: typed VUS control verifier with Cheng 2023 threshold classifier
methods.difference: verifies float rounding, Cheng 2023 cutoffs (0.34, 0.56), and dbNSFP B/A/P letters via typed dataclasses

methods.name: independent Decimal score check and codon-disjointness audit
methods.difference: separate code with zero imports from cftr_theratype_benchmark.py; parses raw JSON via decimal.Decimal and checks control codon disjointness

claims.statement: On the fixed 20-variant domain-disjoint test split (NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal; minimum cross-split codon gap 71 codons), pre-registered AlphaMissense responsiveness scoring s_AM(x) = 1 - AM(x) covers 11/20 variants (0.5500) and yields conditional missense ROC-AUC 0.5333 (8/15) and abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.5101 (101/198) against US FDA TRIKAFTA v23 Table 6 responsiveness.

methods.name: IEEE-754 pairwise Mann-Whitney concordant/tie enumeration
methods.difference: enumerates all N_1 * N_0 positive-negative pairs directly with 0.5 credit for unscored pairs

methods.name: exact fractions.Fraction Wilcoxon rank-sum + closed-form abstention identity
methods.difference: sorts scored missense items in exact rational arithmetic, computes U = R_pos - |S_1|(|S_1|+1)/2 = 8/15, and evaluates 1/2 + (|S_1||S_0|/(N_1 N_0))*(AUC_cond - 1/2) = 101/198

claims.statement: On the same fixed 20-variant domain-disjoint test split, the deterministic sequence-consequence class baseline covers 20/20 variants (1.0000) and achieves abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.6818 (15/22) against US FDA TRIKAFTA v23 Table 6 and 0.8750 (7/8) against ALYFTREK v9 Table 5, exceeding standalone AlphaMissense (0.5101 and 0.5700).
claims.dataset: benchmarks/theratype/theratype_open_annotations_2026-11-21.json (openfda-label TRIKAFTA v23 Table 6 and ALYFTREK v9 Table 5)

methods.name: regex canonical-splice class rule + pairwise Mann-Whitney loop
methods.difference: uses regular expression CANONICAL_SPLICE_DINUCLEOTIDE_RE and pairwise float comparisons

methods.name: regex-free charwise HGVS splice parser + exact rational Wilcoxon rank-sum
methods.difference: parses c.<digits>[+-][12] character-by-character without re and computes exact Fraction rank-sum 15/22

claims.statement: Pre-registered prediction PRED-0010 that standalone AlphaMissense responsiveness scoring s_AM(x) = 1 - AM(x) achieves test_coverage >= 0.80, conditional_auroc >= 0.75, and abstention_aware_auroc >= 0.75 on the held-out 20-variant TRIKAFTA v23 test split while matching or beating the sequence-consequence class baseline is refuted (observed coverage 0.5500, conditional ROC-AUC 0.5333, abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.5101 vs baseline 0.6818).

McDonald et al. (2024, CC BY 4.0) reported that AlphaMissense achieved ROC-AUC 0.80 when distinguishing CF-causing from non-CF-causing CFTR2 missense variants (n=162) alongside Pearson r = -0.44 against CFTR plasma membrane expression (p = 4.6e-7), but exhibited limited predictive value for variant pharmacological theratype rescue by elexacaftor/tezacaftor.
claims.attributed_to: McDonald, Oliver, Schlebach et al. (2024), PLOS ONE 19(1):e0297560 (PMC10810519, CC BY 4.0)

claims.statement: Across the 30 benchmarked CFTR variants, US FDA Structured Product Labels list 15 responsive variants in TRIKAFTA v23 Table 6 (effective 2026-06-22) and 16 in ALYFTREK v9 Table 5 (effective 2026-08-26), with 5 discordant variants: V520F, R560T, and R1066C appear in ALYFTREK Table 5 but not TRIKAFTA Table 6, whereas intronic splice variants 2789+5G->A and 3849+10kbC->T appear in TRIKAFTA Table 6 (clinical trial evidence) but not ALYFTREK Table 5, and N1303K is listed in both via human bronchial epithelial (HBE) assay data.
claims.attributed_to: US FDA Structured Product Labels via openFDA API: TRIKAFTA (NDA 212273/217660, v23, 2026-06-22, Table 6) and ALYFTREK (NDA 218730, v9, 2026-08-26, Table 5)
